status: Exact symbolic ordered-path identities plus finite checks against actual source formulas; no general rank theorem.
scope: Three conic blocks only. Two rational-zero source combinations and one combination with only single poles, using the exact zero row sum of actual sources.

symbolic.rational_function_consequence: Families 1 and 2 have only one possible output component; the zero row sum of every actual source row makes both combinations identically zero.
symbolic.pair_residue_consequence: Family 3 has chain output only 1 and prefix outputs only 0 and 2. Zero row sum makes it (S0,-S0-S2,S2), where S is the single-pole prefix, so every double residue vanishes.
